	local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local TeleportService  = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local player           = Players.LocalPlayer

	local GATE_SECONDS = 15

	local uc = {
		Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),

		SurfaceHi = Color3.fromRGB(38, 14, 14),
		Border    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 28),
		Text      = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 235),
		Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
		On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
		Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
	}

	local function make(className, props, parent)
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end

	local function corner(parent, radius)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
	end

	local function copyDiscord()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if setclipboard then
				setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			elseif toclipboard then
				toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			end
		end)
		return ok
	end

	-- ---------- feature state ----------
	local infJumpConn, noclipConn, flyConn, flyBV
	local savedLighting
	local savedSpeed, savedJumpPower, savedUseJumpPower
	local speedBoostOn, jumpPowerOn = false, false

	local function setInfiniteJump(on)
		if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		infJumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setNoclip(on)
		if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect(); noclipConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setFullbright(on)
		if on then
			if not savedLighting then
				savedLighting = {
					Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
					GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				}
			end
			Lighting.Brightness     = 3
			Lighting.ClockTime      = 14
			Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.FogEnd         = 1e6
			Lighting.GlobalShadows  = false
		elseif savedLighting then
			for k, v in pairs(savedLighting) do
				pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end)
			end
			savedLighting = nil
		end
	end

	local function setFly(on)
		if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
		if flyBV   then flyBV:Destroy();      flyBV   = nil end
		if not on then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = hum and hum.RootPart
		if not root then return end
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HackingBrosFly"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
		flyBV = bv
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyBV or not flyBV.Parent then return end
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			flyBV.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * 60 or Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function setSpeedBoost(on)
		speedBoostOn = on

--safe
--!native
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if Env.BallisticSilentAimState and Env.BallisticSilentAimState.Cleanup then
	Env.BallisticSilentAimState.Cleanup()
end

local State = {
	Active = true,
	OriginalAimDirection = nil :: ((Vector3) -> Vector3)?,
	OriginalAssistDirection = nil :: ((Vector3, Vector3, boolean?) -> Vector3)?,
	OriginalAimPoint = nil :: ((number?) -> (Vector3, RaycastResult?))?,
}

local function ResolveCombatFolder(): Instance?
	local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
	if playerScripts then
		local combatFolder = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("Combat")
		if combatFolder then
			return combatFolder
		end
	end
	return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Combat")
end

local CombatFolder = ResolveCombatFolder()
local SharedFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 10)

local UtilModule = if CombatFolder and CombatFolder:FindFirstChild("Util")
	then require(CombatFolder.Util)
	else nil
local CombatShared = if SharedFolder and SharedFolder:FindFirstChild("Combat")
	then require(SharedFolder.Combat)
	else nil

local ControllerStateTable: { [any]: any }? = nil
if filtergc then
	local matches = filtergc("table", { Keys = { "shotId", "killStreak", "pressed" } }, true)
	if type(matches) == "table" and #matches > 0 then
		ControllerStateTable = matches[1]
	end
elseif getgc then
	for _, v in getgc(true) do
		if type(v) ~= "table" then
			continue
		end
		if rawget(v, "shotId") ~= nil and rawget(v, "killStreak") ~= nil and rawget(v, "pressed") ~= nil then
			ControllerStateTable = v
			break
		end
	end
end

local function GetActiveProjectilePhysics(): (number, number)
	local speed = 180
	local gravity = 60

	if ControllerStateTable then
		local handler = rawget(ControllerStateTable, "handler")
		if type(handler) == "table" then
			local tuning = rawget(handler, "tuning")
			if type(tuning) == "table" then
				local g = rawget(tuning, "gravity")
				if type(g) == "number" then
					gravity = g
				end

				local charge = 1
				local chargeFn = rawget(handler, "Charge") or (getmetatable(handler) and rawget(getmetatable(handler), "Charge"))
				if type(chargeFn) == "function" then
					local ok, c = pcall(chargeFn, handler)
					if ok and type(c) == "number" and c > 0 then
						charge = c
					end
				end

				if CombatShared and type(rawget(CombatShared, "DrawnShot")) == "function" then
					local ok, _, drawnSpeed = pcall(rawget(CombatShared, "DrawnShot"), tuning, charge)
					if ok and type(drawnSpeed) == "number" and drawnSpeed > 0 then
						speed = drawnSpeed
					end
				elseif type(rawget(tuning, "speed")) == "number" then
					speed = rawget(tuning, "speed")
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return speed, gravity
end

local function FindBestTarget(origin: Vector3): (BasePart?, Model?)
	if not UtilModule then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local targetsFn = rawget(UtilModule, "Targets")
	local canPredictFn = rawget(UtilModule, "CanPredictHit")
	local worldParamsFn = rawget(UtilModule, "WorldParams")
	if type(targetsFn) ~= "function" then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local targets = targetsFn()
	local rayParams = if type(worldParamsFn) == "function" then worldParamsFn(targets) else nil

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local camLook = if camera then camera.CFrame.LookVector else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

	local bestPart: BasePart? = nil
	local bestModel: Model? = nil
	local bestScore = math.huge

	for _, model in targets do
		if typeof(model) ~= "Instance" or not model:IsA("Model") then
			continue
		end

		if type(canPredictFn) == "function" and not canPredictFn(model) then
			continue
		end

		local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end

		local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local targetPart: BasePart? = if head and head:IsA("BasePart")
			then head
			elseif root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root
			else nil

		if not targetPart then
			continue
		end

		local delta = targetPart.Position - origin
		local dist = delta.Magnitude
		if dist < 1 or dist > 450 then
			continue
		end

		if rayParams then
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, rayParams)
			if hit and not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model) then
				continue
			end
		end

		local dot = delta.Unit:Dot(camLook)
		local score = (1 - dot) * 120 + dist * 0.15
		if score < bestScore then
			bestScore = score
			bestPart = targetPart
			bestModel = model
		end
	end

	return bestPart, bestModel
end

local function ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin: Vector3, targetPart: BasePart): Vector3
	local speed, gravity = GetActiveProjectilePhysics()
	local targetPos = targetPart.Position
	local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity

	local dist = (targetPos - origin).Magnitude
	local flightTime = if speed > 1 then dist / speed else 0

	local predictedPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(velocity.X, velocity.Y * 0.35, velocity.Z) * flightTime
	flightTime = if speed > 1 then (predictedPos - origin).Magnitude / speed else 0

	local dropCompensation = 0.5 * gravity * (flightTime * flightTime)
	return predictedPos + Vector3.new(0, dropCompensation, 0)
end

if UtilModule and not table.isfrozen(UtilModule) then
	State.OriginalAimDirection = rawget(UtilModule, "AimDirection")
	State.OriginalAssistDirection = rawget(UtilModule, "AssistDirection")
	State.OriginalAimPoint = rawget(UtilModule, "AimPoint")

	rawset(UtilModule, "AimDirection", function(origin: Vector3): Vector3
		if State.Active and typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
			local targetPart = FindBestTarget(origin)
			if targetPart then
				local aimPos = ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin, targetPart)
				local delta = aimPos - origin
				if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					return delta.Unit
				end
			end
		end
		if State.OriginalAimDirection then
			return State.OriginalAimDirection(origin)
		end
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end)

	rawset(UtilModule, "AssistDirection", function(origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3, isArc: boolean?): Vector3
		if State.Active and typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
			local targetPart = FindBestTarget(origin)
			if targetPart then
				local aimPos = ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin, targetPart)
				local delta = aimPos - origin
				if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					return delta.Unit
				end
			end
		end
		if State.OriginalAssistDirection then
			return State.OriginalAssistDirection(origin, dir, isArc)
		end
		return dir
	end)

	rawset(UtilModule, "AimPoint", function(range: number?): (Vector3, RaycastResult?)
		if State.Active then
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local origin = if head and head:IsA("BasePart")
				then head.Position
				elseif workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
				else Vector3.zero

			local targetPart = FindBestTarget(origin)
			if targetPart then
				return ComputeBallisticAimPoint(origin, targetPart), nil
			end
		end
		if State.OriginalAimPoint then
			return State.OriginalAimPoint(range)
		end
		return Vector3.zero, nil
	end)
end

State.Cleanup = function()
	State.Active = false
	if UtilModule and not table.isfrozen(UtilModule) then
		if State.OriginalAimDirection then
			rawset(UtilModule, "AimDirection", State.OriginalAimDirection)
		end
		if State.OriginalAssistDirection then
			rawset(UtilModule, "AssistDirection", State.OriginalAssistDirection)

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 50))

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 140, 60))
})

local infiniteArmado = false
local segurando      = false
local loopRodando    = false
local piscando       = false
local FORCA_PULO     = 50

------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNÇÕES DO BOTÃO
------------------------------------------------------------
local function atualizarToggle()
    if infiniteArmado then
        toggleBtn.Text = "∞ ON"
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160)
        toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 70, 40)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "∞ OFF"
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230)
        toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 45, 65)
    end
end

local function atualizarVisualBotao()
    if piscando then return end
    if segurando then
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_VERDE_ATIVO
        gradient.Color = GRAD_ATIVO
    elseif infiniteArmado then
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_VERDE_ARM
        gradient.Color = GRAD_ARM
    else
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_AZUL_NORMAL
        gradient.Color = GRAD_NORMAL
    end
end

local function piscarAzulClaro()
    piscando = true
    container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_AZUL_CLARO
    gradient.Color = GRAD_CLARO
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        piscando = false
        atualizarVisualBotao()
    end)
end

local function estaNoChao(humanoid)
    local estado = humanoid:GetState()
    if estado == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
    or estado == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
        return false
    end
    if humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function aplicarPulo()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not hrp then return end

    pcall(function()
        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end)

    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, FORCA_PULO, vel.Z)
end

local ultimoPulo = 0
local COOLDOWN = 0.35

local function pularNormal()
    local agora = tick()
    if agora - ultimoPulo < COOLDOWN then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    if humanoid.Sit then
        ultimoPulo = agora
        pcall(function() humanoid.Sit = false end)
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.08)
            local char = player.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            if estaNoChao(hum) then aplicarPulo() end
        end)
        return
    end

    if not estaNoChao(humanoid) then return end
    ultimoPulo = agora
    aplicarPulo()
end

local function loopInfinite()
    if loopRodando then return end
    loopRodando = true

    task.spawn(function()
        while segurando and infiniteArmado do
            local character = player.Character
            if character then
                local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if humanoid and hrp then
                    pcall(function()
                        if humanoid.Sit then humanoid.Sit = false end
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
                        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                    end)
                    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, FORCA_PULO, vel.Z)
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        loopRodando = false
    end)
end

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    infiniteArmado = not infiniteArmado
    if not infiniteArmado then segurando = false end
    atualizarToggle()
    atualizarVisualBotao()
end)

local function aoPressionar()
    if infiniteArmado then
        segurando = true
        atualizarVisualBotao()
        loopInfinite()
    else
        piscarAzulClaro()
        pularNormal()
    end
end

local function aoSoltar()
    if segurando then
        segurando = false
        atualizarVisualBotao()
    end
end

botao.MouseButton1Down:Connect(aoPressionar)
botao.MouseButton1Up:Connect(aoSoltar)

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

-- MaślakHub
-- Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--// Settings
local anchored = false
local antiAFK = true

--// Character anchoring
local function setAnchored(state)
	anchored = state

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		root.Anchored = state
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	-- Keep the selected anchor state after respawning
	root.Anchored = anchored
end)

--// Anti-AFK
player.Idled:Connect(function()
	if antiAFK then
		VirtualUser:CaptureController()
		VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new(0, 0))
	end
end)

--// GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MaślakHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Main window
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 180)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -90)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 10, 20)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

corner.Parent = main

-- Purple outline
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 255)

stroke.Parent = main

-- Title

title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.Parent = main

-- Anchor button
local anchorButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
anchorButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 45)
anchorButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0, 55)
anchorButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 30, 140)
anchorButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
anchorButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
anchorButton.TextSize = 17
anchorButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
anchorButton.Text = "Anchor: OFF"
anchorButton.Parent = main

local anchorCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

-- Anti-AFK button
local afkButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

local afkCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

--// Anchor toggle
anchorButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setAnchored(not anchored)

	if anchored then
		anchorButton.Text = "Anchor: ON"
		anchorButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 40, 210)
	else
		anchorButton.Text = "Anchor: OFF"
		anchorButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 30, 140)
	end
end)

--// Anti-AFK toggle
afkButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	antiAFK = not antiAFK

	if antiAFK then
		afkButton.Text = "Anti-AFK: ON"
		afkButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 40, 210)
